verse.verse_2: By the Book that makes things clear,
verse.verse_3: surely We sent it down on a blessed night, We have always sent warnings,
verse.verse_4: on that night every wise decree is specified
verse.verse_5: by Our own command -- We have been sending messages,
verse.verse_6: as a mercy from your Lord, He hears all and knows all,
verse.verse_7: He is the Lord of heaven and earth and all that is between them, if only you would really believe,
verse.verse_8: there is no deity save Him: It is He who gives both life and death -- He is your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers,
verse.verse_9: yet, they toy with their doubts.
verse.verse_10: Wait, then, for the Day when the sky brings forth plainly visible clouds of smoke.
verse.verse_11: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful punishment.
verse.verse_12: Then they will say, "Lord, relieve us from this torment, for truly we are now believers in You."
verse.verse_13: How can they benefit from admonition, seeing that a messenger had already come to them explaining things clearly?
verse.verse_14: Then they turned away from him and said, "He is a madman, taught by others!"
verse.verse_15: Were We to ease the torment for a while, you would still revert to denial of the truth.
verse.verse_16: On the Day We inflict the direst scourge upon all sinners, We will certainly exact retribution.
verse.verse_17: We tried the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them,
verse.verse_18: saying, "Hand over God's servants to me. I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
verse.verse_19: Do not set yourselves above God: I bring you clear authority.
verse.verse_20: I have sought refuge with my Lord and your Lord lest you stone me [to death].
verse.verse_21: If you do not believe in me, at least keep away from me."
verse.verse_22: Then he cried out to his Lord, "These are sinful people."
verse.verse_23: God said, "Set out with My servants by night, for you will certainly be pursued.
verse.verse_24: Leave the sea behind you parted; they are a host destined to be drowned."
verse.verse_25: How many gardens and fountains they left behind them,
verse.verse_27: and pleasant things in which they delighted!
verse.verse_28: Such was their end, and what had been theirs We gave to other people to inherit.
verse.verse_29: Neither heaven nor earth wept for them, nor were they allowed any respite.
verse.verse_30: We saved the Children of Israel from their humiliating torment
verse.verse_31: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds.
verse.verse_32: We knowingly chose them above all other people
verse.verse_33: and showed them signs in which there was a clear test.
verse.verse_34: Yet those who deny the truth say,
verse.verse_35: there is nothing beyond our first death; we shall not be raised again.
verse.verse_36: So bring our fathers [back], if what you say is true.
verse.verse_37: Are they better than the people of Tubba' and those who came before them? We destroyed them, because they were guilty of sin.
verse.verse_38: We did not idly create the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them;
verse.verse_39: We did not create them save with a purpose, yet most people have no knowledge of this.
verse.verse_40: Truly, the Day of Decision is the appointed time for all of them,
verse.verse_41: the Day when no friend shall be of the least avail to another, nor shall any be helped,
verse.verse_42: save those to whom God shows mercy. Surely, He is the Mighty, the Merciful One.
verse.verse_43: Surely the fruit of the Zaqqum tree
verse.verse_44: shall be food for the sinners:
verse.verse_45: like the dregs of oil, it shall boil in their bellies,
verse.verse_46: like the boiling of hot water.
verse.verse_47: [A voice will cry], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of Hell.
verse.verse_48: Then pour boiling water over his head as punishment.
verse.verse_49: Taste this; you who considered yourself the mighty, the honourable!
verse.verse_51: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place,
verse.verse_53: dressed in fine silk and in rich brocade, and they will face each other:
verse.verse_54: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes.
verse.verse_55: They will call therein for every kind of fruit, in peace and security.
verse.verse_56: They will not taste death therein, save the first death. God will save them from the torment of Hell
verse.verse_57: as an act of grace. That will be the supreme triumph.
verse.verse_58: We have made this Quran easy to understand, in your own language, so that they may take heed.
verse.verse_59: Wait then; they too are waiting.
